integrity: Self-contained analytic proof with finite sanity-check code. No external or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three simple Blaschke zeros with prescribed radii r,r,s; no claim for fully unequal radii or larger systems.
Determinant optimization only, not optimal spectral conditioning.
The quarter-power limit fixes s in (0,1) and sends r to 1.
General classical Fekete rearrangement results may furnish an equivalent statement under other terminology.
title: Exact mixed-radius Szegő orbit determinant design and its quarter-power angular collapse
